about: Written by scripts/build-explorer-index.mjs from each film's own links (films/<slug>.json: deeper, differ, end). The pages outside the Explorer on which each moving picture is offered. Do not edit by hand.

the-exodus.title: The Exodus: out of Egypt
the-exodus.line: God's people were slaves in Egypt, and God set them free. The story as the Bible tells it, in seven pictures, from the brick yards to the far side of the sea.

david-and-goliath.title: David and Goliath
david-and-goliath.line: A giant, a frightened army, and a shepherd boy with a sling. The story as the Bible tells it, in seven pictures, and what it is really about.

book-genesis.title: Genesis: the book of beginnings
book-genesis.line: The first book of the Bible: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-psalms.title: Psalms: the prayer book of the Bible
book-psalms.line: The Bible's book of prayers and songs: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-john.title: John: the Word made flesh
book-john.line: One of the four books about Jesus: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-romans.title: Romans: the good news, set out
book-romans.line: Paul's longest letter: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-exodus.title: Exodus: out of slavery, to God
book-exodus.line: The second book of the Bible: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-proverbs.title: Proverbs: skill for ordinary days
book-proverbs.line: The Bible's book of wise sayings: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-isaiah.title: Isaiah: the Holy One who comforts
book-isaiah.line: The longest book of the prophets: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-matthew.title: Matthew: God with us
book-matthew.line: The first book of the New Testament: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-mark.title: Mark: the story at a run
book-mark.line: The shortest of the four books about Jesus: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-luke.title: Luke: good news for the lost
book-luke.line: The longest of the four books about Jesus: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-acts.title: Acts: to the ends of the earth
book-acts.line: The book that tells what happened after Jesus rose: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-revelation.title: Revelation: the Lamb on the throne
book-revelation.line: The last book of the Bible: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-ruth.title: Ruth: loyal love in a hard time
book-ruth.line: A short story of two women, a field and a kind man: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-jonah.title: Jonah: the prophet who ran from mercy
book-jonah.line: A short book about a prophet who ran away, a storm, a great fish and a great city: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-daniel.title: Daniel: the Most High rules
book-daniel.line: A book of brave stories and strange visions: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-1-corinthians.title: 1 Corinthians: a gifted church, coming apart
book-1-corinthians.line: A letter to a church that was gifted, proud and quarrelling: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-ephesians.title: Ephesians: one new people in Christ
book-ephesians.line: A letter from prison about God's great plan and one family made from two: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-philippians.title: Philippians: joy in chains
book-philippians.line: A thank-you letter from a prisoner to his friends: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-hebrews.title: Hebrews: hold on to Jesus
book-hebrews.line: A long letter to believers who were tired of believing: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-james.title: James: faith that works
book-james.line: A short letter of sharp, practical sayings from the brother of Jesus: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-joshua.title: Joshua: a promise kept
book-joshua.line: The book of a river crossed and a land given: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-judges.title: Judges: a people coming apart
book-judges.line: The book of the years when Israel kept forgetting God: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-1-samuel.title: 1 Samuel: the heart God sees
book-1-samuel.line: The book of a boy who heard God, a tall king and a shepherd: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-jeremiah.title: Jeremiah: the prophet who wept
book-jeremiah.line: The book of a prophet who warned his city and kept speaking when no one listened: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-galatians.title: Galatians: nothing added to Christ
book-galatians.line: An urgent letter about who belongs to God's family: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-colossians.title: Colossians: complete in Christ
book-colossians.line: A short letter about how great Jesus is: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

book-1-peter.title: 1 Peter: hope for strangers
book-1-peter.line: A letter of hope to people who felt like strangers in their own towns: what it is, how it is put together, what to watch for, and where to start reading.

holy-spirit.title: The Holy Spirit through the Bible
holy-spirit.line: The Holy Spirit from the Bible's first page to its last, in eight pictures. The Holy Spirit is God. He is a person, not a force.

the-king.title: The king
the-king.line: God's people waited a long time for a good king. Seven pictures follow one crown, from a shepherd boy to a cross to a throne that lasts for ever.

covenant.title: Promises that build: the covenants
covenant.line: God makes promises and keeps them. Seven pictures follow the covenants, from Noah's rainbow to the cup Jesus shared, each one laid on the one before like the stones of an arch.

the-lamb.title: Sacrifice and the Lamb
the-lamb.line: From the garden to the last page, God provides. Seven pictures follow a covering, a ram, the Passover lamb and the altar to Jesus, the Lamb of God, and the Lamb at the center of the throne.

why-blood.title: Sacrifice: why blood?
why-blood.line: The Bible talks about blood from its first pages to the cross. Seven pictures show why: blood means a life given, and God himself gives it.

exile-and-home.title: Exile and coming home
exile-and-home.line: Again and again in the Bible, God's people are far from home, and again and again God brings them back. Seven pictures follow one road, from the garden gate to a city whose gates are never shut.

kingdom-of-god.title: The kingdom of God
kingdom-of-god.line: Jesus said the kingdom of God is like a tiny seed that grows into a great tree. Seven pictures watch it grow, from God's rule over all to the day it comes in full.

light-and-darkness.title: Light and darkness
light-and-darkness.line: The Bible begins in the dark and ends in a city with no night. Follow one light all the way through.

who-god-is.title: Who God is: Father, Son and Holy Spirit
who-god-is.line: There is one God, the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. Eight pictures of what the Bible shows, and why every other picture breaks.

image-of-god.title: Creation and the image of God
image-of-god.line: God made everything out of nothing, and he made people in his own image. Seven pictures of what that means for every person.

what-sin-is.title: What sin is
what-sin-is.line: What sin is, what it breaks, and what God does about it, in six pictures.

who-jesus-is.title: Who Jesus is
who-jesus-is.line: Jesus is God the Son, who became a real man. Seven pictures of who he is, and why it matters.

why-jesus-died.title: Why did Jesus die?
why-jesus-died.line: What happened on the cross, and the Bible's own pictures of what it did for us, in eight pictures.

the-resurrection.title: The resurrection
the-resurrection.line: What Christians believe happened on the third day, and why it matters, in seven pictures: a tomb, a breakfast, a stone split in two and the first sheaf of a harvest.

how-salvation-works.title: How salvation works
how-salvation-works.line: The good news of Jesus in nine pictures: what went wrong between people and God, what God did about it, and the new life he gives.

grace.title: Grace: the gift no one earns
grace.line: Grace is God's love that we do not have to earn. Seven pictures show what it is, what it cost, and what it does in a person.

faith.title: Faith: trusting the one who promised
faith.line: Faith is trusting God because he keeps his word. Seven pictures show what faith is, how it grows, and why even a little of it is enough.

gospel-in-a-minute.title: The gospel in a minute
gospel-in-a-minute.line: The good news of Jesus, short enough to share, in seven pictures: what went wrong, what God did about it, and the gift he gives.

spirit-in-a-believer.title: The Holy Spirit in a believer
spirit-in-a-believer.line: The Holy Spirit is God, and he lives in everyone who belongs to Jesus. Seven pictures of what he does there.

the-church.title: What the church is
the-church.line: The church is not first a building. It is people, gathered by God's Spirit around Jesus. Seven pictures of what that means.

baptism-and-supper.title: Baptism and the Lord's Supper
baptism-and-supper.line: Jesus gave his church two things to do: baptism with water, and a meal of bread and a cup. Seven pictures of what Christians share, and where churches do them differently.

the-bible.title: The Bible: how we got it
the-bible.line: How the Bible came to us, in seven pictures: many writers, words spoken and written down, scrolls and ink, copies made by hand, a new kind of book, and every language.

prayer.title: Prayer
prayer.line: Prayer is talking with God, who is our Father. Seven pictures of what prayer is, and what to do when an answer is slow to come.

life-to-come.title: The life to come
life-to-come.line: What Christians believe about dying, and about what God will do at the end. Seven gentle pictures, from a seed in the ground to a world made new.

john-3-16.title: John 3:16 in its chapter
john-3-16.line: One of the best-known verses in the Bible comes from a talk in the dark between Jesus and a teacher named Nicodemus. Seven pictures tell the whole of it.

psalm-23.title: Psalm 23: the LORD is my shepherd
psalm-23.line: One of the best-loved songs in the Bible, one line at a time: a shepherd, green grass, a dark valley, a feast, and a home at the end of the road.

romans-8-28.title: Romans 8:28: what it promises, and what it does not
romans-8-28.line: A verse people say when something sad happens. Seven pictures look closely at what it promises, and at what it does not.

who-made-god.title: Who made God?
who-made-god.line: A real question, taken seriously, in six pictures: everything we know came from something, so where did God come from?

does-god-exist.title: Does God exist?
does-god-exist.line: One of the biggest questions there is, taken slowly and honestly in six pictures: why is there anything at all?

why-cant-i-see-god.title: Why can't I see God?
why-cant-i-see-god.line: An honest question, in seven pictures: why no one can see God with their eyes, and the ways he has made himself known, most of all in Jesus.

why-bad-things-happen.title: Why do bad things happen?
why-bad-things-happen.line: A hard and honest question, in eight pictures: what the Bible says about pain, what it does not explain, and who has the last word.

is-the-bible-true.title: Is the Bible true?
is-the-bible-true.line: Can we trust a book so old, copied by hand for hundreds of years? An honest look in eight pictures.

did-jesus-come-back-to-life.title: Did Jesus really come back to life?
did-jesus-come-back-to-life.line: Christians say Jesus died and came back to life. Is it true? An honest look at what happened, in seven pictures.

when-we-die.title: What happens when we die?
when-we-die.line: A gentle answer to a big question, in seven pictures: what the Bible says happens when someone who belongs to Jesus dies, and why Christians can be sad and hopeful at once.

so-many-churches.title: Why are there so many churches?
so-many-churches.line: There are so many different churches on so many signs. Seven pictures of how one church became many, and the one root they still share.

never-heard.title: What about people who never heard?
never-heard.line: Many people have lived without ever hearing about Jesus. What does the Bible say, and what do Christians believe? An honest look at a hard question.

temple-destroyed.title: Why did God let his temple be destroyed?
temple-destroyed.line: God's people had a beautiful temple, and one day it was burned. Why would God let that happen? What the prophets said, and how the story went on.

love-when-i-do-wrong.title: Does God still love me when I do wrong?
love-when-i-do-wrong.line: Everyone does wrong sometimes. Does God stop loving us then? Jesus answered with a story about a son who ran away and a father who ran too.

god-silent.title: Why does God seem silent sometimes?
god-silent.line: When you pray and nothing seems to happen, you are in good company. Seven pictures of people in the Bible who felt it too, and what God did.

science-and-the-bible.title: Are science and the Bible enemies?
science-and-the-bible.line: Do you have to choose between loving God and loving science? Seven pictures on why the answer is no, and on what Christians agree and disagree about.
